Just so you know, some decks actually use the fact you can bring out
another copy of a burned vampire... Some of the "Turbo Decks" you
might see referenced work on bringing out a vampire, having that
vampire do a handful of actions and then burning the vampire... to
then bring out a new copy of the vampire and repeat that set of
actions... over and over again.

So not only is it legal, it is sometimes a key tactic for a deck.
